about:
# Decorate the Objects Automatically!

***how to use***
1. Select Objects
2. Click Palette
3. and **Done**!

***<cy>Customizable Settings</c>***
- **editor layer of decorations**
- **Randomized <cj>Rotations</c>**
- **Randomized <cr>Scales</c>**

**Preview levels made using this mod!**
[Showcase](https://youtu.be/Ii1pAVlT1zA)
